title: Add the documentation specialist profile to .lore/agents/ (fourth of four, OPAG-688)
description:
Add the documentation specialist profile to .lore/agents/, the fourth of four.

The opum-workflow documenter specialist compiles its context pack from the profile named "documentation", so it cannot dispatch in this repository today: origin/dev carries only implementation, review and verification (verified locally by listing .lore/agents/). OPAG-33 left documentation out of the original worker repositories on purpose; OPAG-417 has since given all four profiles to the web and marketplace repositories, so uniformity now means four (opum-ai/opum-agent OPAG-688, read by ref at opum-agent dev 026b55d). lore-web's LWEB-98 is the worked example: its documentation.toml pins the bundle index and sources the active Story, controlling Spec, and runbooks.

Dispatched by the orchestrator under OPAG-688 on 2026-09-28, ranked behind QCLI-405/406/407 and not preempting them.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A documentation profile exists on the delivery branch at .lore/agents/documentation.toml with schema_version 1, name documentation, kind specialist, max_tokens inside the range the existing three profiles use (9000-12000), and pinned plus sources naming this repo own docs bundle, modeled on lore-web LWEB-98 output

The proof is a before/after control pair, both captured: with the profile absent, lore agent context documentation --task QCLI-408 exits 0 but stderr carries the warning that the documentation profile was not found and the pack catalog holds only bundle-wide query hits; with the profile present, stderr carries no such warning and the catalog is the one the profile sources define
The delivery PR required checks are green on its head SHA

plan: Model the profile on lore-web documentation.toml (LWEB-98 output, read by ref at lore-web dev a14d6dd) with this bundle own docs: index pinned, active Story, controlling Spec, operations runbook

Prove the pack with a before/after control pair, both captured: absent profile gives exit 0 plus the not-found warning and a bundle-wide-hits catalog (LCLI-575 degraded pack); present profile gives exit 0, no warning, and the profile-source catalog
bun run check and lore check, PR into dev, required checks green on the head SHA, squash merge, close on the delivery PR
implementationNotes: AC2 proof pair captured 2026-09-28: BEFORE (profile moved aside, then restored) lore agent context documentation --task QCLI-408 exits 0, stderr carries the not-found warning, and the catalog shows "Allowed source catalog: None" plus bundle-wide query hits only. AFTER: exit 0, stderr 0 bytes, catalog is the profile sources (index pinned 1/1, Story included 1/1, Spec 1/16 partial, delivery-graph 13/27 partial at budget 12000). The runbook and ADR are ranked omitted-by-budget by lore per-task ranking, the same normal source-list behavior the existing three profiles share. Note: the original control expectation of exit 3 was wrong for current lore - LCLI-575 made a missing profile a degraded pack with exit 0, which is exactly why the orchestrator corrected AC2 to the before/after shape.
